rows.purpose: 6 phases: relaxed quiet breath, slight inhale, half blink, slow closed blink, open eyes, return. Small smile, RIGHT mic below chest, LEFT hand relaxed. Tiny ponytail tip and shirt hem sway. Feet planted, no singing/waving/dancing. Visible subtle variation.

8 successive small light running gait phases toward SCREEN RIGHT: right contact, compression, passing, lift, left contact, compression, passing, lift. Alternate legs clearly, slight body bob. Wide trouser volume and platform shoe lift/contact readable, ponytail gently lags. RIGHT mic secure, LEFT arm natural. Face travel direction.

8 successive light running phases toward SCREEN LEFT, alternating legs with slight bob; wide cargo legs and platform shoe contacts readable. Independently redraw, NEVERmirror: keep RIGHT gold mic, correct print/hair braid/belts/earpiece. Ponytail lags naturally. Face travel direction.

4 phases: left hand begins relaxed, gently raises, small friendly wave with small head tilt and bright smile, softly returns. RIGHT mic held steady below chest. Ponytail softly follows, no wave marks.

5 phases: tiny knee bend, takeoff, low joyful airborne apex with both feet off ground, soft bent-knee landing, recover. Keep same head/body scale. Ponytail rises then settles; preserve cargo volume and shoes. RIGHT mic never leaves hand. No ground/landing effects.

8 phases: smile softens away, eyes lower, lips gently pressed or tiny cheek puff, mild cute regret, brief pause, head lifts, confidence returns, soft smile. Restrained expression, stable feet, no crying or effects.

6 phases: slight head tilt, free LEFT palm softly opens, patient bright expectant eyes, calm blink, reopen, warm attentive held asking pose. RIGHT mic low and steady. Friendly playful but not impatient. Distinct from idle and chin thinking.

6 phases of TASK WORK not locomotion: lower RIGHT mic slightly, free LEFT fingertips lightly at chin, focused eyes, thoughtful pause, gentle nod, refocus. Feet planted. No running or singing. Avoid mic over face.

6 phases: slight forward head lean, eyes observe one side, other side, thoughtful pause, small confirming nod, tiny approving free-LEFT-hand gesture with satisfied smile. RIGHT mic secure below face. Distinct from chin-thinking and idle.
